title: HS40083: Food Security And Poverty Studies
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: None Course ContentsFood Security Issues, Causes and Nutritional
Imbalance; Definition of Food problems: Famine, Under-nutrition, Overnutrition, Malnutrition and its Measurement,; Food Distribution systems
Developing Countries (e.g., PDS, Food Bank, Mid-day Meal, Food Co-operative,
etc.); Food Security in India; Global Food Balance and the Scenario in the
Developing World; Income Inequalities; Economic Development and Diversification
of Diet; Factors affecting Demand for Food; Supply of food and its
determinants; Resource use and Sustainability. Gender Equity and Human Rights
relating to Sustainable Food Production, Effects of Trade in Food availability
and Diets, Types, Effectiveness and Differences between LDCs and Developed
countries with respect to Food Security and Intra-Household Distribution
Issues; Urban vs. Rural Food and Nutritional Security in India; Definition,
Causes and Measurement of Poverty, Intersection between: Gender and Poverty;
Health and Poverty, Urbanization and Poverty, Poverty Reducing Strategies of
International Organizations, Policy choices and Markets.
